title: [review] tx_queue.py:501: complete() signals success
description: reservation.set_result(True) is called on lines 501-502 BEFORE checking if entry is still at queue front on line 505. If entry was expired/removed between reserve() and complete(), the reservation incorrectly signals success for a dropped packet. The set_result call should be inside the 'if self._entries and self._entries[0] is entry' block.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-1fu6 - fixed in same change: complete() now removes entry wherever it is and always signals reservation
